description: Expander adding ten more CV outputs built from the cell counts C42 makes; it goes immediately to the right of C42

outputs.text: The row-left and row-right counts added together, one channel per play head
The column-above and column-below counts added together, one channel per play head
The whole row count plus the whole column count, one channel per play head
The whole row count minus the whole column count, one channel per play head
The whole column count minus the whole row count, one channel per play head
The two counts along the main diagonal, above-left plus below-right, added together, one channel per play head
The two counts along the anti diagonal, below-left plus above-right, added together, one channel per play head
The main diagonal count plus the anti diagonal count, one channel per play head
The main diagonal count minus the anti diagonal count, one channel per play head
The anti diagonal count minus the main diagonal count, one channel per play head
